title: Pi Workbench · PoC
modeNote: Real config: uses the local Pi configuration and credentials, with all extensions/MCP/Skills loaded; conversations may go online and incur costs.
composerPlaceholder: Type a message. Enter to send, Shift+Enter for a new line; paste images or drop any file
modelNote: Sorted by popularity; click a vendor to expand its models, click a model to stage the /model command. “Added” means saved as a model module.
providerNote: Custom providers are written to the real local Pi config (models.json + auth.json) with an automatic backup; new providers take effect after a new Pi session.
paletteHint: Commands that run directly are written to the terminal with Enter; ones that need arguments are placed in the composer.
mediaHint: Scroll to zoom · drag to pan · Esc to close
